$notes.about: A hero preset (content/heroes/<id>.json, listed in web/src/engine/content-library.ts HERO_FILES; the Godot Content autoload reads the folder). Colours are sRGB hex.
$notes.look.palette: suit = body, trim = gloves, boots, belt and mask, accent = emblem and metal details, cape, skin, hair
$notes.look.build: height in metres (1.7-2.1); shoulders and bulk are multipliers on the reference hero (1 = v1's hero)
$notes.look.cape: length and hem width in metres, or null for no cape (the cloth sim is skipped)
$notes.flight: multipliers on content/tuning/flight.json: speed (cruise, boost, launch, minimum, dive bonus), acceleration (cruise, boost), turnRate (yaw rates)
$notes.powers: loadout = the powers this hero carries; the scales multiply the power tuning for slam radius, throw speed and the heaviest thing the hero can grab
